But the brief points against it. The curve is bundle-dominated: top-3 share of 1.0, bundle share of 1.0, and a top-5 buyer share of 99.8% in the first two minutes. Those 784 SOL of early buys came from about 20 buyers, with a launch bot present and a sell-to-buy ratio near zero. That is operator-style accumulation, and the last 15 minutes show it: 10 SOL bought, 8.6 SOL sold, and net flow of only 1.5 SOL. Demand is thin relative to the 5.2M market cap, and the sellers are already active.

I see no evidence that real demand will persist for 30-60 minutes. Skip.
memos.skeptic: The most likely loss path is insider distribution after the operator-backed launch. Bundle_share is 1.0 and top3_share is 1.0, so one operator controls essentially the whole curve, and the first two minutes after graduation show 784 SOL bought from 20 buyers with a top-5 buyer share of 99.8% and a sell-to-buy ratio of 0.0003. That pattern means the operator accumulated and the public was never meant to get in early. In the last 15 minutes, sell_sol (8.56) is 85% of buy_sol (10.08) and 31 sellers exceed 42 buyers in count, so distribution has already started. The 30-minute return of +4.6% is a thin, fee-sized gain (our round trip is 1.4-5.1%) with a drawdown of only 0.13% from the high, which means the next move is likely a sell into our buy. Recommend skipping.
